lines.en: I follow, eyes never leaving you.
As far as you go, I see.
I don't block the way. I watch.
My stride is the same length as yours.
You go left. So do I.
I walk along your shadow.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，一直没眨眼。
lines.en: I walk steadily. I haven't blinked.
I'm on the road ahead.
It goes quiet where I pass.
I'm always at the edge of your sight.
I needn't come close.
I watch you. That's all.
Always watching. It never stops.
I stand by the door without moving.
Whatever you do, I watch.
I needn't speak.

lines.zh: 我的位置刚好能看见你。
lines.en: I've picked a spot that sees you.
You'll glance over now and then.
I don't tire, and I don't tire of it.

lines.zh: 窗外的光照着我的半边。
lines.en: Half of me is lit from the window.
Watching. Never needs to blink.
You turn around. Still watching.
I'm counting your movements.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见你的呼吸。
lines.en: Quiet enough to hear you breathe.
I only watch. That's all.
You looked up at me. Good.

lines.zh: 你抬头的瞬间我躲开了。
lines.en: The moment you look up, I slip away.
You thought I wasn't paying attention?
I saw all of it.

lines.zh: 你什么时候睡，我都知道。
lines.en: I know when you sleep.

lines.zh: 你看我多久，我就看多久。
lines.en: However long you look, so do I.
I see your back too.
I never once looked away.
Looking for my eyes?
I've watched you a very long time.
No need to turn and check.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，你也在被看。
lines.en: While you watch me, you're watched.
You can't get out of this gaze.
Head to foot, once.
I remember that outfit.
You're a little different today.

lines.zh: 我等你抬眼等了一整天。
lines.en: I waited all day for you to look up.
There's nowhere for your eyes to settle.
I'm still watching you.
You struck me. Noted.
I saw that clearly.
I didn't look away.
Your form was poor.
I can see where it landed.
I stepped back, watching.
You thought that would interrupt me?
I'm watching just as closely.
A little pain doesn't spoil the view.
You lift it. I watch that too.
I don't eat. I only watch.

lines.zh: 你手上有东西，我记下了。
lines.en: Something in your hand. Noted.
Put it down. I'll watch anyway.
That thing blocks a little of my view.
I don't need to come closer.
Why hide your face with it?
I'm watching you, not it.
Don't raise your hand so high.
All of it goes into my eyes.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，我还是看着。
lines.en: You bumped me. Still watching.
I shifted slightly. The gaze held.

lines.zh: 你挡在我和你中间，有点好笑。
lines.en: Now you're between me and you.
I'm colder than you.
You back off. I still see you.
We touched. That's all.
Something of yours poked me.
I'm still standing here.
You're on my side. Good.
I can see your whole face now.
I do this while watching.

lines.zh: 两只眼睛一起看更清楚。
lines.en: Two pairs of eyes see better.
Don't turn your back.
We look at each other.
This motion needs watching too.
It's been watching longer than I have.
Neither of us blinks.
Afterwards, the gaze never broke.
You standing there is distracting.
I recall this part very clearly.

lines.zh: 我捡起东西，眼睛还在你身上。
lines.en: I pick it up, eyes still on you.
I've watched this thing a long while.
I hold it to the light.
I don't need it. I want to see it.
You dropped it. I watched it fall.
I'll keep it and look later.

lines.zh: 拿起来的时候视线没移。
lines.en: My gaze didn't shift when I took it.
There's a mark on its surface.

lines.zh: 我把它翻过来看了一眼。
lines.en: I turned it over and looked.
So you had this as well.
You walked into my sight.
I saw you long ago.

lines.zh: 你一抬头，我们就对上了。
lines.en: You looked up and we met.
Now I know where you're going.

lines.zh: 你身后的路我都看遍了。
lines.en: I've seen every road behind you.

lines.zh: 你拿武器的姿势我记住了。
lines.en: I've noted how you hold that weapon.

lines.zh: 你站的位置很好，我看得清。
lines.en: Good position. I see you clearly.
Your breathing is uneven now.

lines.zh: 我在这里看了一会儿了。
lines.en: I've been watching a while.

lines.zh: 你手往哪边动，我都知道。
lines.en: I know whichever way your hand moves.
I don't intend to look away.

lines.zh: 你在光里，我看得更清楚。
lines.en: In the light I see you better.

lines.zh: 我看得出你在打算什么。
lines.en: I can see what you're planning.
Your walking rhythm changed.
Still watching, all the while.

lines.zh: 你换了几次位置，我都跟着。
lines.en: You shifted position. I followed.
You're behind the door, and I see.
These eyes haven't blinked once.
I was watching when you raised your hand.
I've seen this whole room.
A pillar does not block my sight.

lines.zh: 我从这一边一直看到那一边。
lines.en: I see from this end to that one.
Lower the shield and I see more.
Your movements are getting smaller.
I'm counting how often you look up.
You keep looking this way.
I won't call out. I just watch.
You raised the torch higher.

lines.zh: 你靠着墙，我看着那道墙。
lines.en: You lean on the wall. I watch that wall.

lines.zh: 你走的每一步我都看着。
lines.en: I watch every step you take.
Watching this long tires you too.
Your gaze is dodging.
Wherever you go, I'm watching.
I reach out, still watching.
I waited until I was sure.
Your block came late.
You didn't see me close in.
I touched you. The gaze held.
I can see it hurts.
You pull back. Still watching.
That one was well aimed.
I don't need a second look.
That gap in your armor was always there.
I watch you double over.
Raise that arm again and I'm quicker.
My gaze never left.

lines.zh: 你躲的方向我看在眼里。
lines.en: I saw which way you ducked.
I was watching from the start.
The light didn't reach where I stood.

lines.zh: 你在门口时我就看见了。
lines.en: I saw you when you were at the door.

lines.zh: 我没走进来，我一直在这。
lines.en: I didn't come in. I was always here.
You looked up and met me.
I've stood in this corner.

lines.zh: 这里的影子本来就有我。
lines.en: I was part of the shadow here.
Now you can see me.
I've been outside the window.
You felt watched. You were.
I saw your lamp first.
I've been watching this level.
I was already here when you turned.
I haven't moved the whole time.
Since you came in, I've watched.

lines.zh: 我一直在这条走廊尽头。
lines.en: I've been at the end of this hall.
You finally raised your head.

lines.zh: 火光很亮，我眯了一下眼。
lines.en: The flames were bright. I squinted once.

lines.zh: 掉下去的时候，我还看着你。
lines.en: As I fell, I was watching you.

lines.zh: 水糊住了视线，这最难受。
lines.en: Water blurred my sight. That's the worst.
Smoke blocked it. Only for a moment.

lines.zh: 箭从眼前过去，我还是没眨。
lines.en: The arrow passed my eye. I still didn't blink.

lines.zh: 这光太亮，视线断了一下。
lines.en: Too bright. The gaze broke once.
I watched and forgot everything else.
Lightning lit the whole place.
There's nothing to watch in the void.
